purpose: Search open research data repositories for downloadable experimental datasets (CSV/XLS) on syringe/needle injection force with viscosity and geometry for Newtonian fluids.

protocol_fields_required.Q: volumetric flow rate or controlled injection time + volume
protocol_fields_required.F_fluid: fluid-side force or pressure (friction-separated or pressure transducer)

search_channels.name: Zenodo REST API
queries: glycerol needle injection force OR glide force OR hagen poiseuille syringe (type=dataset)
"injection force" AND (syringe OR needle) AND (viscosity OR glycerol OR Newtonian)
"glide force" OR "break loose" syringe OR "expulsion force" needle viscosity
title:(injection AND force) AND (syringe OR needle OR viscosity)
search_channels.result_summary: Exact-phrase and Boolean queries for injection/glide force + syringe/viscosity returned 0 relevant hits. Broad keyword queries returned thousands of irrelevant records (syringe services programs, MD glycerol viscosity, medieval syringe 3D models, filtration robots). No downloadable experimental injection-force panel found.

search_channels.name: DataCite REST API
search_channels.result_summary: 43 hits for 'injection force syringe' — most theses/immune-system noise; useful hits redirected to Springer Nature Figshare collections for intravitreal syringe force papers (see datasets). No complete Newtonian fluid-resistance CSV registered under DataCite.

search_channels.name: Dryad API v2
search_channels.result_summary: count=0 for targeted query. Web site search for injection force + syringe/needle viscosity also empty.

search_channels.name: Figshare API / Springer Nature Figshare
queries: web: site:figshare.com injection force syringe viscosity
search_channels.result_summary: Two real downloadable / open supplementary packages related to syringe force vs viscosity (ophthalmic IVI and autoinjector time). Neither meets full Phase D field bar for F_fluid + measured geometry.

search_channels.name: EuropePMC REST
search_channels.result_summary: hitCount large (~2919) with HAS_DATA flag not reliably populated; top hits include Ackermann 2026 and Felfeli 2026 (OA). Data availability statements often 'upon request' rather than repository deposit of complete panels.

search_channels.name: Web / Google-style dataset queries
queries: syringe injection force viscosity needle glycerol dataset CSV OR XLS site:zenodo.org OR site:figshare.com OR site:datadryad.org
"injection force" syringe needle viscosity dataset OR supplementary glycerol Newtonian
"Hagen-Poiseuille" syringe force experiment data OR dataset viscosity needle
"raw data" OR supplementary "injection force" glycerol water syringe needle
site:data.mendeley.com injection force syringe OR needle viscosity OR glycerol
"friction" glycerol ("glide force" OR "injection force") syringe (supplementary OR dataset OR zenodo OR figshare)
search_channels.result_summary: No OSF/Mendeley/Harvard Dataverse deposits of row-level Newtonian syringe fluid-force tables found. Classic literature (Allmendinger 2014, Verwulgen 2018, Zhang 2018) discussed in papers/PDFs; not open machine-readable complete panels with friction-separated F_fluid.

datasets_found.title: Additional file 10 of Guiding syringe selection for intravitreal injections... (Table S2. Unaggregated eye characteristics and raw injection force data)
datasets_found.license: CC BY 4.0 / CC0 for data (Figshare license value 47: CC BY + CC0)
datasets_found.description: Row-level time series of injection pressure/force into cadaver eyes for 15 cP and 120 cP viscosity mimics across several syringe brands (StaClear, ClearJect, BD, ZR0.2) with 27G needle. Columns include date, syringe, fluid_density (viscosity label), EYEID, needle, IOP, inj_max, inj_mean, inj_time, and force samples vs time.

fields_present.mu: partial — labeled 15 cP and 120 cP viscosity mimics (not glycerol series; composition of mimics not in XLSX)
fields_present.d: no — gauge only (27G), no measured ID
fields_present.L: no — needle length not tabulated in XLSX
fields_present.barrel: partial — syringe brand only; plunger/barrel ID not numeric in file
fields_present.Q: no — inj_time present but not controlled fixed Q; manual clinical-style injection into eye
fields_present.F_fluid: no — total injection effort into tissue (includes friction + tissue backpressure); not fluid-only resistance

datasets_found.phase_d_notes: Real downloadable experimental force data, but wrong measurand (tissue injection), incomplete geometry, no friction separation.

datasets_found.title: The effect of syringe design and cannula dimensions on time-force curve in intravitreal injection across different drug viscosities
datasets_found.license: CC BY 4.0 (article); SI on Springer Nature Figshare CC BY + CC0
datasets_found.format: Published tables (peak force N; AUC N·s) in main text; SI DOCX/PDF stats (ANOVA). Raw time-series: 'available from corresponding author upon reasonable request' — not a public CSV/XLS deposit.
datasets_found.access: open article tables; SI supplementary stats; raw data on request only
datasets_found.description: Manual force-gauge expulsion of 0.1 mL of four fluids (BSS, PEG-40000, PEG-400, Tween80+BSS) through 30G (13 mm) and 33G (9 mm) cannulas with three syringe plunger diameters (~2.48, 4.71, 4.76 mm). Complex viscosity measured on rheometer at 25 °C.

fields_present.mu: partial — complex viscosity η* at one frequency (27.25–13656 mPa·s); fluids are PEG/Tween solutions, not certified Newtonian glycerol–water panel
fields_present.d: no — gauge only (30G/33G), no measured ID
fields_present.L: yes — cannula lengths stated (13 mm / 9 mm)
fields_present.Q: no — manual injection; time varies; no fixed Q
fields_present.F_fluid: no — total resistance force (friction + hydrodynamic); empty-syringe friction not subtracted

datasets_found.phase_d_notes: Best open tabular near-miss for geometry×viscosity×force factorial design, but total force, manual Q, gauge-only needle ID, non-glycerol fluids. Not a friction-separated F_fluid validation panel.

datasets_found.title: Enabling faster subcutaneous delivery of larger volume, high viscosity fluids (supplementary materials)
datasets_found.format: DOCX supplementary tables/figures (statistical contrasts on delivery time; not force CSV)
datasets_found.description: Large-volume autoinjector delivery duration vs Newtonian solution viscosity (2.3–50 cP), spring force tiers, and 27G/29G wall types — in air and in vivo. Outcomes are time/volume/depot, not plunger force or needle ΔP.

fields_present.Q: partial — delivery time under spring drive (not imposed constant Q)
fields_present.F_fluid: no — spring force category only; no measured F_fluid

datasets_found.phase_d_notes: Explicitly Newtonian viscosities, but wrong primary measurand (injection time under spring force, not fluid resistance force).

classic_literature_not_open_datasets.citation: Allmendinger et al., Eur J Pharm Biopharm 2014 — Rheological characterization and injection forces of concentrated protein formulations
classic_literature_not_open_datasets.note: Uses glycerol/water as Newtonian surrogate and Hagen–Poiseuille glide-force prediction; no open CSV/XLS deposit found in Zenodo/Figshare/Dryad.

classic_literature_not_open_datasets.citation: Verwulgen et al., Pharm Res 2018 — Assessment of forces in intradermal injection devices
classic_literature_not_open_datasets.note: Water–glycerol Newtonian mixtures and hydrodynamic vs human factors; institutional PDF/snippets exist; no public row-level repository dataset with complete μ,d,L,barrel,Q,F_fluid.

classic_literature_not_open_datasets.citation: Zhang et al., AAPS PharmSciTech 2018 — Assessment of Injectability via Measurement of Total Work
classic_literature_not_open_datasets.note: HPMC/PEO non-Newtonian; total work/DGF metrics; not open fluid-only force panel.

verdict.summary: No open repository dataset provides a downloadable CSV/XLS experimental panel for Newtonian syringe/needle injection with complete fields μ, measured d, L, barrel, Q, and friction-separated F_fluid (or equivalent pressure). A few near-miss open files exist (total force or autoinjector time with viscosity labels) but fail the protocol bar.
verdict.implication: Phase D independent experimental validation remains blocked from repository sources alone. Requires new benchtop glycerol–water campaign with pressure/load-cell + empty-friction baseline, or full text+SI of a paper that already publishes friction-corrected hydrodynamic force as machine-readable rows.
